instruction: A leaping dolphin rendered as a glowing neon wireframe: bright emissive cyan edges tracing the polygonal hull with dark translucent faces, like a holographic wire sculpture floating in space.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE neon wireframe dolphin in a glowing neon wireframe hologram style. A leaping dolphin rendered as a glowing neon wireframe: bright emissive cyan edges tracing the polygonal hull with dark translucent faces, like a holographic wire sculpture floating in space. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
